Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_local_time date;
 v_creation_date date;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select distinct ord.customer_id, bx.insert_date, bx.warehouse_id
 into :ctrl_blk_1.customer_id, :creation_date, :ctrl_blk_1.warehouse_id
 from boxes bx, pick_slip_products psp,
 pick_slips ps, orders ord
 where bx.box_id = :ctrl_blk_1.box_id and
 bx.box_id = psp.box_id and
 psp.pick_slip_id = ps.pick_slip_id and
 ps.order_no = ord.order_no and
 ord.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 psp.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 ps.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 bx.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0334');
 check_package_failure;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 message
 ('Too many rows found in query for this box id');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message
 ('Error in checking from query - 10');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 if :global.is_time_enabled_value ='Y' then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:ctrl_blk_1.creation_date,v_local_time);
 
 :ctrl_blk_1.creation_date := v_local_time; 
 
 else
 :ctrl_blk_1.creation_date := :ctrl_blk_1.creation_date;
 end if;
 
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-CHANGE
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 begin
 select name
 into :s_customer_name
 from customers
 where customer_id = :ctrl_blk_1.customer_id
 and chapter_id = :s_chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in finding customer - 2');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_local_time date;
begin
 begin
 select code_desc into :s_box_type_desc
 from vserv_box_types
 where code = :box_type;
 select code_desc
 into :s_box_status_desc
 from vserv_box_status
 where code = :box_status;
 select code_desc
 into :s_prod_group_desc
 from vserv_master
 where code_type = 'PRDGP' and code = :product_grouping;
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 null;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select distinct co.consignee_id, co.name
 into :boxes.consignee_id, :s_consignee_name
 from consignee co, vserv_order_classes voc 
 where co.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 and voc.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and exists 
 (select 'x' from orders ord, customers cu, boxes bx,
 pick_slips ps, pick_slip_products psp
 where bx.box_id = psp.box_id
 and bx.box_id = :ctrl_blk_1.box_id 
 and co.consignee_id = ord.consignee_id
 and co.customer_id = ord.customer_id
 and cu.customer_id = co.customer_id
 and ord.order_no = ps.order_no 
 and ord.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 and ps.pick_slip_id=psp.pick_slip_id
 and voc.order_class = ord.order_class 
 and cu.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and bx.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and ps.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and psp.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id );
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting of consignee-2');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if :shipment_no is not null
 then
 begin
 select shipments.consignee_id, name
 into :boxes.consignee_id, :s_consignee_name
 from shipments, consignee
 where shipment_no = :shipment_no and
 shipments.consignee_id = consignee.consignee_id and
 shipments.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and
 consignee.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting of consignee-1');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 
 if :global.is_time_enabled_value ='Y' then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:boxes.packed_date,v_local_time);
 
 :boxes.ctrl_packed_date := v_local_time; 
 
 else
 :boxes.ctrl_packed_date := :boxes.packed_date;
 end if;
 
 /* This is commented by Edwin becuase the closed date is stroed as local date in the packing screen 
 
 if :global.is_time_enabled_value ='Y' then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:boxes.closed_date,v_local_time);
 
 :boxes.ctrl_closed_date := v_local_time; 
 
 else
 :boxes.ctrl_closed_date := :boxes.closed_date;
 end if;
 */
 :boxes.ctrl_closed_date := :boxes.closed_date;

end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
--chk_digit_query returns the check digit of the unit ID
 :pick_slip_products.chk_digit := chk_digit_query(:pick_slip_products.unit_id,
 :pick_slip_products.coll_date,:GLOBAL.chapter_id);

--Modified for both schemes to coexist
 select abo_desc
 into :s_abo_desc
 from vserv_abo
 where abo_code = :pick_slip_products.blood_type
 AND unit_scheme_type = decode(:pick_slip_products.chk_digit,NULL,'C','I')
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 365);
 
 :pick_slip_products.ctrl_exp_date := :pick_slip_products.exp_date;
end;
